# The Political Illusion

*[Jacques Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) · 1965*

[Ellul](../philosophers/ellul.md) argues there that belief in the omnipotence of politics is an illusion: the modern state, overtaken by technical and administrative necessities, decides less and less, while every problem is presented as political.
